# vcop (Virtua Cop, Revision B; original Model 2): entry points the recompiler cannot
# find by itself. The MAME harvest (scripts/run_trace.sh's branches.txt: the targets of
# indirect branches and calls, the interrupt handlers and the IAC target) over 3,600 and
# 8,000 frames of attract and a scripted 9,000-frame game (shots across the screen,
# reloads), then scripts/seed_scan.py --append; the interrupted addresses are not seeds.
# Addresses only (our own analysis; rules.md rule 7). One hex address per line.
